description: Données brutes de ponctualité J-1 - Ruwe gegevens van stiptheid D-1 - Raw punctuality data D-1 is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. Raw data about arrival and departure of passenger trains (domestic and international) at their stopping points over a day and by train number. The relations and lines are also given. This dataset is updated on a daily basis with the previous day's data (the data is overwritten every morning). Delays are given in seconds. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in CSV. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
